cause: The synchronous interval body can overrun its nominal 1 second interval when workspace packages run concurrently on a constrained CI runner; this is scheduling sensitivity in a timing assertion, not a semantic or transport failure.
repair: The test now requires at least two completed interval measurements, which proves an interval boundary was crossed without requiring an environment-dependent count.
notes: The run was inspected through the GitHub job log API.
No test was disabled and no semantic assertion was relaxed.
